purpose: Guarded frame-0 support diagnostics for F6-S1 and F6-S2 products with a decoder-enclosing native integrity boundary and explicit GenCase position-only mode.

native_integrity.pre: full BI4 SHA and dev/ino/bytes/mtime/ctime immediately before official decoder entry
native_integrity.decoder: official decoder must return frame.saved_file.path, frame.saved_file.bytes, and frame.saved_file.sha256; legacy frame.source_file is rejected
native_integrity.post: full BI4 SHA and stat after decoder return, including decoder failure cleanup
native_integrity.acceptance: pre SHA == decoder SHA == post SHA and pre stat == post stat; known producer SHA is checked at both boundaries
native_integrity.v2_failure: ROOT255 V2 looked for frame.source_file; the actual decoder returns frame.saved_file and V2 therefore failed before scientific decoding credit
native_integrity.v3_acceptance: the caller validates the complete saved_file path/bytes/SHA shape, then compares it with the guarded post SHA/stat
native_integrity.v5_failure_preservation: when decoder raises, post SHA/stat and scratch cleanup run without requiring saved_file; the original decoder exception/type/message remains primary and any finalization error is attached as context
native_integrity.v5_success_requirement: saved_file path/bytes/SHA is required only after a successful decoder return
native_integrity.v5_no_legacy_alias: source_file is never accepted as saved_file
native_integrity.v5_cli_fixture: six manufactured producer/XML/BI4/Fluid/Bound cases are exercised through the actual worker CLI; failure mutations must be rejected
